name: zp
description: ZeroParse grammar files: syntax highlighting, and diagnostics, formatting, navigation, hover, rename and completion from the zp language server

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace, the workspace cannot choose the command that runs the language server (zp.server.path).

zp.server.enabled.description: Start the ZeroParse language server (zp lsp) for .zp files. Syntax highlighting works without it.

zp.server.path.description: The zp command that runs the language server: a name looked up on the PATH, or an absolute path. In an untrusted workspace, the workspace's value is ignored.

zp.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and the language server in the ZeroParse Language Server output channel.

zp.server.experimentalLint.description: Enable experimental lint diagnostics, guarded explanations, version-checked quick fixes (suppression, merging overlapping character-class ranges, removing a lookahead that always succeeds, and deleting an unused rule) and responsive analysis. Restart the language server when this setting changes.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-grammar.js && node scripts/check-extension.js && node scripts/check-lint-actions.js && node --unhandled-rejections=strict scripts/check-client.js
